scoringRules.leadingPrediction: A venue counts as predicted-leading when judgment is 'leading', or judgment is 'plausibly_leading' with confidence 'high'. Universe venues absent from the prediction count as predicted-not-leading.
scoringRules.venueAgreement: (TP + TN) / universe size across all cases; false positives on expected-not-leading venues lower the score, so predicting every venue as leading cannot reach the gate.
